attempts.rationale: trend_dominated and weighted hint suggest using inverse_error weights over full pool.
The series is trend-dominated with high predictability; a simple mean of all models may serve as a baseline comparison.
Test a DBA (Dynamic Bayesian averaging) approach, which is a different kind of weighted combination than inverse_error and may handle correlated errors better.
Try a robust aggregation (median) to see if it outperforms weighted on this trend-dominated series.
Test a trimmed mean to see if discarding extreme high-error models improves over median in this trend-dominated, moderately ranked series.
per‑horizon top‑k mean weighting on the 7‑model pool

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.402.
